## Chapter purpose

Learn how statistical questions connect populations, samples, variables, numerical summaries, and visual evidence.

## Topics

::: {.statx-topic-grid}
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>2.1</span>
### Types of data
Categorical versus numerical; discrete versus continuous.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>2.2</span>
### Population versus sample
Parameters, statistics, sampling, representativeness, and bias.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>2.3</span>
### Descriptive statistics
Mean, median, mode, range, variance, and standard deviation.
:::
::: {.statx-topic-card}
<span>2.4</span>
### Data visualization
Histograms, boxplots, distribution shape, center, spread, and unusual observations.
:::
